info.title: FSHRMS — Attendance API
info.description:
Time + absence: punches, shifts, daily attendance projection, leaves,
overtime, regularization, holidays, and the multi-stage approval flow
shared by leave / OT / regularization. Hosts the leave / OT /
regularization approval inboxes with stage-aware filtering and
delegation expansion.

tags.name: Attendance
tags.description: Punches + daily attendance records. Self-portal punching, operator-added punches (single + bulk), operator amend / delete, biometric batch ingest, and per-employee read views. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.write` / `attendance.operator` / `attendance.admin`.

tags.name: Holidays
tags.description: Holiday calendar — listing for everyone, CRUD for HR. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.admin`.

tags.name: Attendance — Org rollups
tags.description: Org-wide attendance aggregates. Two queries — one for a single date (HR dashboard's `OrgPulse`) and one for a range (the 30d trend chart). Both require `attendance.read` (HR scope).

tags.name: Leaves
tags.description: Leave requests, multi-stage approvals, balances, leave types. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.write`.

tags.name: Approval history
tags.description: Lists approval decisions (APPROVED or REJECTED) the caller closed at any stage of any leave / OT / regularization request, in a date range. Used by the manager / HR "my approvals" screen. Requires `attendance.read`.

tags.name: Attendance reports
tags.description: Standard exportable reports owned by attendance-service. Requires `attendance.reports.run` (or `attendance.leaves.reports.run` for leave reports).

tags.name: Device sync (poller)
tags.description: Service-account surface drained by the attendance-poller sidecar (`services/attendance-poller`). Claims sync tasks, reports outcomes, and pushes the per-cycle device heartbeat. Requires `attendance.poller`.

tags.name: Employee templates (poller)
tags.description: Service-account surface for the attendance-poller sidecar to fetch template bytes for a PUSH_TEMPLATE task and to upload newly captured templates from the enrollment device. Upload is store-only — provisioning to devices is a separate, operator-chosen step (POST /devices/{id}/users/{employeeId}/push-templates). Requires `attendance.poller`.

tags.name: Attendance — Composites
tags.description: Read-only composites that pair attendance rows with employee summaries via the shared employee-display cache. Replaces the legacy BFF composites that fanned out via HTTP for what is ultimately one service's data.

tags.name: Attendance Periods
tags.description: Period-level lock used by payroll's lock-attendance step. The presence of a lock row IS the lock — POST /lock is idempotent, POST /unlock removes it. Listing requires `attendance.read`; mutating requires `attendance.admin`.

tags.name: Shift overrides
tags.description: Operator-driven per-employee overrides over a date range. Triggers same-tx recompute of attendance_records snapshots + minutes for every date in the range. Reads require `attendance.read`; writes require `attendance.operator` (held by ATTENDANCE_OPERATOR, HR, ADMIN). Every write emits an audit event onto the per-entity timeline.

tags.name: Regularization
tags.description: Formal employee-driven flow for missed check-ins / check-outs. Final-stage approval writes punches with source=REGULARIZED and triggers re-derivation of the day's row. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.write`.

tags.name: Approval delegations
tags.description: Lets a manager hand approval authority to another user over a date range. Resolution is dynamic — assigned_to on approval_steps is never rewritten. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.write` / `attendance.approval.override`.

tags.name: Attendance devices
tags.description: Catalog of biometric / kiosk devices that emit punches. Owned by IT_OPS / ADMIN. Every management endpoint requires `attendance.devices.admin`; the poller-targets feed stays on `attendance.poller`.

tags.name: Attendance + leave analytics
tags.description: JSON aggregations for the /analytics dashboards. Requires `attendance.analytics.read` (or `attendance.leaves.analytics.read` for leaves).

tags.name: Overtime
tags.description: Overtime authorization. Self-apply, bulk apply for a department, batch approve / reject. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.write` / `attendance.overtime.bulk`.

tags.name: Short leaves
tags.description: Sub-day leave: leave work between (startTime, endTime) on a given date with HR approval. Distinct from regularization (forgot-to-punch) and from full/half-day leave_requests. Requires `attendance.read` / `attendance.write`.

post.summary: Push an employee's captured fingerprints onto a device (HR)
post.description: Queues a PUSH_TEMPLATE task per stored fingerprint template so the poller provisions the employee's prints onto THIS device — the deliberate, operator-chosen counterpart to capture (which is store-only). Call it on each device you want the employee's prints on; reusable any time (e.g. when a new gate is added) with no re-scan, since the print is already in the central store. The employee must already be enrolled on this device and the device must be active. FACE templates are skipped. Returns the queued task(s). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

404.description: DEVICE_NOT_FOUND, DEVICE_USER_NOT_FOUND (employee not on this device), or EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND.

422.description: DEVICE_INACTIVE (target not active) or TEMPLATES_NOT_FOUND (employee has no captured fingerprints yet — capture first).

post.summary: Capture an employee's fingerprints off a device (HR)
post.description: Queues a CAPTURE_TEMPLATE task for the poller to read the employee's enrolled fingerprint templates off this device — typically the enrollment device, right after the employee placed a finger on the keypad — and store them centrally. Store-only: capture does NOT push to any other device. To provision the print onto the device(s) you choose, call POST /devices/{id}/users/{employeeId}/push-templates on each target afterwards. The employee must already be on this device. Returns the queued task so the FE can track it via GET /devices/{id}/sync-tasks. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

404.description: DEVICE_NOT_FOUND, DEVICE_USER_NOT_FOUND (employee not on this device), or EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND (no attendance snapshot for the employee yet).

post.summary: Bulk un-enroll users from a device (HR)
post.description: Post-adoption cleanup. Removes the listed matched employees (by id; bridge row dropped) and/or stray device users (by raw deviceUserId; no bridge) from the device — each queues a DELETE_USER for the poller. Unknown ids are skipped, not failed. POST (not DELETE) because it carries a body. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.
Re-arms a task that has parked in FAILED — flips back to PENDING with attempts=0 and scheduled_for=now. The next poller cycle picks it up. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

422.description: SYNC_TASK_NOT_FAILED — task is not in FAILED status.

post.description: `retryable=false` parks the row in FAILED immediately. `retryable=true` (default) increments attempts and re-arms with exponential backoff (min(60s × 2^attempts, 1h)) until the configured max-attempts cap, after which the row stays FAILED for HR to retry.
Flips the task to DONE and applies side effects: UPSERT_USER stamps `attendance_device_users.synced_at`; PUSH_TEMPLATE flips `has_fingerprint` / `has_face` on the bridge row.

422.description: Task is not IN_PROGRESS (already completed / failed).

get.description: Newest first, no payloads — counts + status + error only. Filter by `status` (PENDING / COMPLETED / FAILED). Default page size 20 (max 100). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by snapshot status. Omit for all.

post.description: Persists a PENDING snapshot row + queues a SNAPSHOT_DEVICE sync task. The poller drains the task, dials the device, and posts deviceInfo / users / attendance JSON back; the snapshot row flips to COMPLETED at that point. Use GET /devices/{id}/snapshots/{snapshotId} to read the dump. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

Renders the full reconciliation to an .xlsx, stores it in object storage, and returns a short-lived signed download URL the FE opens directly — the human-readable alternative to the raw JSON snapshot. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

Posted after a SNAPSHOT_DEVICE task completes. Body carries the deviceInfo / users / attendance JSON dumped from the device. The service stores them on the snapshot row, flips its status to COMPLETED, and marks the linked sync task DONE in the same transaction.

Posted when a SNAPSHOT_DEVICE task can't be fulfilled. Same retry/backoff policy as a regular task fail — `retryable=true` (default) re-arms with exponential backoff up to the cap; `retryable=false` parks the task in FAILED. The snapshot row is flipped to FAILED only on the terminal failure (after backoff is exhausted or retryable=false).

post.summary: Adopt a snapshot's users into the bridge (HR)
post.description: Reconciles a COMPLETED snapshot's user dump into the device's attendance_device_users bridge — the cutover path for devices that already carry enrollments. Each device user_id (leading zeros stripped) is matched to an employee_code; the bridge row is created or its privilege / syncedAt refreshed, and users with no matching employee are skipped and returned. Idempotent — re-run after adding a device or to pick up keypad-side enrollments. Does NOT set hasFingerprint / hasFace (get_users can't report template presence). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

422.description: DEVICE_SNAPSHOT_NOT_COMPLETED — snapshot has no captured users yet.

post.description: Nulls `last_punched_at` so the next poller cycle pulls every record currently on the device. Use after a device clock reset or to re-ingest a swathe of records whose bridge rows landed late. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.
Updates `attendance_devices.status` + `last_seen_at`. Called by the poller on every cycle (success or fail) so the dashboard freshness indicator stays current.

post.summary: Set the device's ZK comm password (HR)
post.description: Write-only. The current value is never returned in any response — the GET endpoints expose `commPasswordSet: bool` instead. Send 0 to clear. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

Aggregates a per-employee payroll snapshot (lopDays, daysPresent, otHours, workingDays, paidDays, absentDays) for the given employees over the given period. Replaces the per-employee `/attendance/employee/{id}` round-trip loop in payroll's compute. Cap 500 (matches payroll's largest run size today). Requires `attendance.read`.

get.summary: List overrides covering a date or for an employee over a range
get.description: Requires `attendance.read`.

post.summary: Create overrides for a list of employees over a date range
post.description: Requires `attendance.operator`.
Hard-delete with a mandatory audit reason; recomputes the day. The audit event is the trail. Requires `attendance.operator`.

Called by attendance-poller. Each punch carries `(employeeCode, deviceId, punchedAt)` — the device's user_id field IS the employee_code. The service resolves to employee_id via attendance_employees, drops same-time duplicates silently, and triggers attendance_records re-derivation in the same transaction. Punches whose employee_code has no snapshot row come back in `skipped[]` with reason `UNKNOWN_DEVICE_USER` and are parked in the unmatched-replay queue. Requires `attendance.poller`.
Records a portal punch for the calling employee. Cap of 2 WEB punches per day. Requires `attendance.write`.

409.description: PUNCH_LIMIT — third WEB punch on the same day.

post.description: 404 if the period is not currently locked. Requires `attendance.admin`.
Idempotent — re-locking returns the existing lock without error. Requires `attendance.admin`.

End-of-shift / paper-form bulk insert. Up to 100 rows per call. Whole batch is one transaction — any failure rolls back the lot. Each row dedups against same-instant duplicates and produces an audit row. Requires `attendance.operator`.

409.description: PUNCH_DUPLICATE on a same-instant collision; whole batch rolled back.

422.description: PUNCH_FUTURE on any row in the batch; whole batch rolled back.

post.description: Operator records a missed punch with a free-text reason. Bypasses the WEB 2/day cap; standard dedup on (employee, exact instant) still applies. Requires `attendance.operator`.
Requires `attendance.write`.

post.summary: Create a delegation on a manager's behalf (HR)
post.description: Requires `attendance.approval.override`.

patch.description: Applies the supplied `displayOrder` to each listed shift in a single transaction. Returns the active catalog. Requires `attendance.admin`.

delete.description: Soft delete — flips `active=false`. Existing balance rows and historical leave requests are preserved; ESS callers stop seeing the type on the apply drawer and dashboard. Re-enable by PATCHing `active=true`. Requires `attendance.admin`.

patch.description: HR-admin partial update. `code` is not updatable. Requires `attendance.admin`.
Patch — null fields stay unchanged. The holiday date is immutable; delete and recreate if the date itself is wrong. Requires `attendance.admin`.

get.description: Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

delete.description: Soft delete — flips `active=false`. Existing punches keep their device_id FK; the row stays available for historical reads. Re-enable by PATCHing `active=true`. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

patch.description: Patch — null fields stay unchanged. `code` is immutable; deactivate and create a new row if the code is wrong. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

delete.summary: Delete an override (reverts every date in the range)

patch.summary: Patch an override (re-triggers recompute over the union of old + new ranges)

patch.description: Updates `punchedAt` on a single punch and rewrites the day's attendance record. If the new instant moves the work-date (pre-shift window), both old and new days are recomputed. The before/after snapshot lands on the audit timeline. Requires `attendance.operator`.

409.description: PUNCH_DUPLICATE — another punch already exists for the new instant.

422.description: PUNCH_FUTURE — new instant is in the future.

get.summary: My OT requests joined with attendance minutes (ESS)
get.description: Returns the caller's OT requests with the attendance record's OT and worked-minutes for the same (employee, workDate) joined in. Minutes are zero when the OT is still PENDING / REJECTED, or when no attendance record exists yet for the day. Requires `attendance.read`.
Requires `attendance.read`.
Requires `attendance.read`.
Paginated. Date filter is overlap-style. Default sort newest-first. Inbox-derived; max page size 200. Requires `attendance.read`.

Paginated list of the caller's leave requests. All filters are optional. Date filter is overlap-style — include any request whose [fromDate, toDate] intersects [from, to]. Default sort is `fromDate,desc`. Default page size 20 (max 200). Requires `attendance.read`.

Without `year`, returns the currently active cycle per leave type (the cycle window containing today — correct for annual anniversary cycles and Jul–Jun fiscal cycles alike). Pass `year` for a historical view: cycles that started in that calendar year. Requires `attendance.read`.
Single round-trip bundle for the apply-leave drawer: leave types catalog, caller's current-year balances, and holidays in the next 90 days.

get.summary: List employees enrolled on a device (HR)
get.description: Bridge rows for the device — employeeId, privilege, hasFingerprint / hasFace flags, last syncedAt. The employee's device-side identifier is the employee_code (resolved through attendance_employees). Default sort `employeeId,asc`. Default page size 100 (max 500). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

get.summary: List sync tasks for a device (HR)
get.description: All sync tasks for a device, newest scheduled_for first. Filter by `status` (repeat for multi-select: PENDING / IN_PROGRESS / DONE / FAILED). Default sort `scheduledFor,desc`. Default page size 50 (max 200). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter tasks by status. Omit for all.

get.summary: Claim next batch of sync tasks
get.description: Atomically claims up to `limit` PENDING tasks for the device whose `scheduled_for <= now` (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED). Empty list when nothing is ready. limit is clamped to [1, 100].

get.summary: Get a device snapshot with payloads (HR)
get.description: Full snapshot: deviceInfo / users / attendance JSON populated when status is COMPLETED. The FE can render these in a viewer or download them as JSON files. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

Paginated device users reconciled against the employee mirror. Filter by `category` (MATCHED_ACTIVE / MATCHED_INACTIVE / UNMATCHED). For UNMATCHED rows pass `deviceUserId` back to the un-enroll endpoint; for matched rows pass `employeeId`. Default page size 100 (max 1000). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by reconciliation category. Omit for all.

get.description: Counts of the snapshot's device users by category: matched-active (keep), matched-inactive (e.g. terminated — un-enroll candidate), and unmatched (stray, no employee — un-enroll candidate). Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.
Active devices with a non-null `deviceIp`, joined to their high-water-mark. **Carries the ZK comm password** — gated to the poller's service account. Requires `attendance.poller`.

Paginated daily-record list across the company. All filters are optional; when no date filter is supplied the response is scoped to today (server-local). `date` is a shortcut for `from=to=date`. `employeeId` wins over `employeeCode`; `departmentId`/`sectionId` are pre-resolved against employee-service. Default sort `attendanceDate,desc;employeeId,asc`. Default page size 50 (max 500). Requires `attendance.admin` OR `attendance.operator` — covers HR, admin, and the attendance-operator persona; managers and plain employees use the per-employee `/me` and `/employee/{id}` endpoints instead.

get.description: Active employees whose shift-start + grace has elapsed today without a check-in punch, most overdue first. Weekend / holiday / approved-leave and not-yet-due shifts are excluded; the list shrinks as people punch in and clears itself — nothing is persisted (distinct from the nightly ABSENT status). Paginated (default 20, max 200); always sorted by `minutesOverdue` descending. Requires `attendance.read`.

get.summary: Org-wide attendance volume per day over a range
get.description: Per-day status counts. Days with no records (rare — usually means the nightly close hasn't run) are absent from the response, not zero rows. Requires `attendance.read`.

One-shot landing payload for the attendance-operator UI: org pulse, today's punch / override / pending-regularization counts, and the two action queues (missing checkouts, late arrivals) enriched with employee summaries. Default date is today (server-local Asia/Karachi). Requires `attendance.admin` OR `attendance.operator`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to roll up. Defaults to today (Asia/Karachi).

get.description: Per-day rows for the calling employee for the supplied calendar month. Requires `attendance.read`.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to current month.

get.description: One round-trip Today view: today's record, today's punches, any approved leave covering today, today's holiday, the next upcoming holiday + approved leave, and a 3-bucket leave balance summary (annual / sick / casual).

get.summary: My punches for a specific day
get.description: Requires `attendance.read`.

Per-day rows for the supplied month, pre-merged with holidays in the month and any approved leaves that overlap the month. Each day carries a `kind` render hint plus the underlying record / holiday / leave overlay.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to current month (Asia/Karachi).

get.description: Per-day status + late variance for the calling employee. Same shape as the per-id endpoint; this one is open to any authenticated employee. Requires `attendance.read`.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to current month.

get.description: Returns a list of attendance records for the given employees on the given date — drives the BFF "team today" composite without N+1 calls. Caller buckets the result by `employeeId`. Cap 200. `date` defaults to today (server-local). Requires `attendance.read`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Employee ids (comma-separated or repeated).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Defaults to today.

get.summary: Per-employee daily attendance over a range (HR / manager)
get.description: Requires `attendance.read`.
Returns today's attendance projection. Always 200: when no punches and no nightly close have produced a record yet, the response is `{ state: NOT_PUNCHED, record: null }`. Requires `attendance.read`.

200.description: Today's projection (record may be null when state == NOT_PUNCHED).

get.summary: Per-employee punches over a range (HR / manager)
get.description: Requires `attendance.read`.

Per-day status + late variance for a calendar month — server-side rollup that drives the dashboard heatmap (D-S5). Falls back to WEEKEND on Sunday and ABSENT on weekdays for days with no record. Requires `attendance.read`.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to current month.

get.summary: Per-employee canteen usage over a range
get.description: Aggregates CANTEEN-typed device events for the employee between `from` and `to` (inclusive). Returns `days` (distinct calendar dates) and `weeks` (distinct 7-day chunks counted from the 1st of the month: days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–28, 29–end). Payroll's compute consumes this to apply the grade-conditional canteen deduction. Requires `attendance.read`.

One round-trip approvals inbox: leaves, overtime, and regularization pending-approval lists fetched in sequence, then enriched with an `employee` summary per row. Counts are the visible totals (not the size of the returned page). Requires `attendance.read`.

Returns one row per stage the caller closed (APPROVED or REJECTED) — unified across leave / OT / regularization. The result is always scoped to the caller; there is no `deciderId` query param. `from` and `to` are required, `to` is inclusive, and the window must be at most 366 days. Default sort `decidedAt,desc`. Default page size 20 (max 200).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Decision date lower bound (inclusive).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Decision date upper bound (inclusive).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by request type. Omit for all.

parameters.name: decision
parameters.description: Filter by decision outcome. Omit for both.

422.description: REQUEST_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE — missing dates, inverted range, or window over 366 days.

get.description: Requires `attendance.read`.
Per leave-type and overall: allocated (incl. carried) + used + pending + used%.
Per month: total leave days + breakdown by leave-type. Window 1..24 months; defaults to 12.
Rolling N-day window. PRESENT / on-time / late / absent / leave counts plus on-time% and OT hours. Window 1..365; defaults to 90.

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: Employee id (upstream system).

get.description: Per month: total OT minutes + OT hours. Window 1..24 months; defaults to 12.
Per month: PRESENT count + on-time count + on-time%. Window 1..24 months; defaults to 12.
Per month: PRESENT+ABSENT+LEAVE denominator + ABSENT count + absenteeism%. Window 1..24 months; defaults to 12.

delete.summary: Remove an employee from a device (HR)
delete.description: Drops the bridge row immediately and queues a DELETE_USER for the poller. If the device is offline, the queued task drains when it returns. Requires `attendance.devices.admin`.

404.description: DEVICE_NOT_FOUND or DEVICE_USER_NOT_FOUND — employee is not on this device.

UploadTemplateRequest.description: Poller posts a captured template here. Store-only — the row is saved centrally; pushing to devices is a separate, operator-chosen step.

fingerId.description: 0..9 for FINGERPRINT; must be null for FACE.

EmployeeTemplateDto.description: A captured biometric template. Bytes are base64 in transit so this DTO is JSON-safe.

CreateShortLeaveRequest.description: Apply for a sub-day leave: leave work between (startTime, endTime) on leaveDate. Total minutes is derived from the window. Different from regularization (which inserts missing punches) and from leave_requests (full or half day).

endTime.description: Must be strictly greater than startTime — no midnight wrap.

ApprovalStepDto.description: One stage in the approval chain. `assignedToName` / `decidedByName` are looked up from employee-service when the controller has access; null otherwise.

CurrentStageDto.description: The PENDING stage of the chain. Null when the request is finalized.

RejectRequest.description: Reason recorded on the approval step.

ApproveRequest.description: Optional note attached to the approval step.

fridayExtraMinutes.description: Extra minutes added to break + end on Fridays only. Null/0 = no Friday adjustment.

displayOrder.description: HR-controlled sort order; lower sorts first.

RegularizationRequest.description: Submit a regularization for a missed check-in / check-out. At least one of `checkIn` / `checkOut` must be set; `reason` is mandatory. The request flows through the same multi-stage approval chain as leaves and OT.

onBehalfOf.description: Submit on behalf of another employee. Caller must be the target's direct manager, or hold `attendance.approval.override` (HR). When set, the MANAGER stage is auto-approved (manager-on-behalf) or the whole chain is auto-approved (HR override).

CreateOvertimeRequest.description: Self-apply OT for a single working day. Authorization-only — no hours/minutes; actual minutes are derived later from `attendance_records.worked_minutes`. The chosen `overtimeType` selects which OT bucket the day's overtime lands in — the other two stay zero.

overtimeType.description: Which OT bucket the day's overtime is credited to.

onBehalfOf.description: Submit on behalf of another employee. Caller must be the target's direct manager, or hold `attendance.approval.override` (HR). When set, the MANAGER stage is auto-approved (manager-on-behalf) or the whole chain is auto-approved (HR override).

overtimeType.description: NORMAL / EXTRA / SPECIAL — the bucket the day's overtime is credited to.

BulkOvertimeRequest.description: Bulk OT submission. All employees must be in the submitter's department; rows for employees with no punch on the date are skipped (returned in `skipped[]`). `overtimeType` applies to every row in the batch.

overtimeType.description: Which OT bucket the day's overtime is credited to, for every employee in the batch.

BulkOvertimeResponse.description: Outcome of a bulk OT submission. `created[]` lists the rows actually written; `skipped[]` lists employee ids that were silently dropped because they had no punch on the date.

CreateLeaveRequest.description: ESS leave application. Sundays + holidays in the range are skipped at submit time.

halfDay.description: True for half-day requests; combine with `halfDayPart`.

onBehalfOf.description: Submit on behalf of another employee. Caller must be the target's direct manager, or hold `attendance.approval.override` (HR). When set, the MANAGER stage is auto-approved (manager-on-behalf) or the whole chain is auto-approved (HR override).

LeaveRequestDto.description: Leave request DTO returned to submitters and approvers.

actions.description: Actions the calling user can take right now.

PerDayDecideRequest.description: Per-day approve/reject — only allowed when the current PENDING stage is the FINAL stage.

CreateLeaveTypeRequest.description: HR-admin create payload. `code` must be unique and is immutable post-create — it is denormalized into balance rows, leave requests, and audit events.

cycleAnchor.description: Entitlement cycle: JOINING (anniversary, e.g. annual leave), FISCAL (Jul–Jun, e.g. M1/Casual), or NONE (occasional, calendar-year lazy).

prorateOnEntry.description: Prorate the first cycle for a mid-cycle joiner. FISCAL types only. Defaults to false.

encashable.description: Encash unused balance when the cycle closes at renewal. Defaults to false.

cycleAnchor.description: Entitlement cycle anchor: JOINING, FISCAL, or NONE.

prorateOnEntry.description: Prorate the first cycle for a mid-cycle joiner (FISCAL types).

encashable.description: Unused balance is encashed when the cycle closes at renewal.

showOnDashboard.description: If false, the dashboard balance card hides this type. It still appears on the apply-leave drawer.

LeavePreviewDto.description: Dry-run shape for the apply-leave drawer. Same business rules submit enforces — Sundays + holidays are skipped, half-day collapses to 0.5, balance projection uses current balances. `warnings[]` carries soft hints (e.g. NEGATIVE_BALANCE, CROSSES_FY) that the FE can surface without blocking submit; the actual submit will still fail hard if a rule is violated.

workingDays.description: Net working days that count toward the request.

balanceAfter.description: Caller's available balance for this leave type after the request lands.

warnings.description: Soft warnings; submit will still attempt with these set.

CreateAttendanceDeviceRequest.description: HR-admin create payload for the biometric / kiosk device catalog. `code` must be unique and is immutable post-create. The comm port is read by the attendance-poller sidecar to open a ZK-protocol session — leave at the default (4370) for stock ZKTeco units. The ZK comm password is set via the dedicated POST /devices/{id}/comm-password endpoint and is never returned in any GET.

enrollment.description: True for the single device HR uses for in-person enrollment. Default false.

deviceType.description: Physical role of the device. Default ATTENDANCE — set to CANTEEN or ACCESS_LOG for units whose punches shouldn't count as attendance.

deviceIp.description: IP address the poller dials in to.

commPasswordSet.description: True when a non-zero ZK comm password has been set. Use POST /devices/{id}/comm-password to set it.

enrollment.description: True for the single device HR uses to enroll fingerprints / faces.

deviceType.description: Physical role of the device. Default ATTENDANCE; flip to CANTEEN or ACCESS_LOG for units whose punches shouldn't count as attendance.

status.description: Last reported by the poller's heartbeat.

lastPunchedAt.description: High-water-mark for biometric ingest. Null when no punch has been received yet or after POST /devices/{id}/reset-hwm.

unmatchedCount.description: Number of unmatched-card punches waiting in the replay queue.

DeviceSyncTaskDto.description: A claimed sync task as the poller sees it. Payload shape varies by taskType (see V0008 SQL comment in the attendance service).

payload.description: Task payload as a free-form object; keys vary by taskType.

UnenrollDeviceUsersRequest.description: Bulk remove enrolled users from a device. Each entry queues a DELETE_USER for the poller and drops the bridge row (if any). Provide matched employees by id and/or stray device users by their raw device user_id. At least one list must be non-empty.

employeeIds.description: Matched employees to un-enroll. Their bridge row is dropped and a DELETE_USER (keyed by employee_code) is queued.

deviceUserIds.description: Raw device user_ids with no employee record (UNMATCHED rows). A DELETE_USER keyed by the raw user_id is queued; there is no bridge row to drop.

UnenrollResultDto.description: Outcome of a bulk un-enroll. DELETE_USER tasks drain on the next poller cycle; offline devices drain when they return.

droppedBridges.description: Bridge rows dropped (matched employees that were enrolled).

skipped.description: Entries skipped (unknown employee id, or blank device user_id).

FailSyncTaskRequest.description: Reported by the poller when a sync task failed against the device. retryable=false (e.g. template format mismatch, unknown user) parks the row in FAILED immediately regardless of attempts; retryable=true (the default) increments attempts and re-arms with exponential backoff until max-attempts is hit.

CompleteSyncTaskRequest.description: Reported by the poller when a sync task succeeded on the device.

detail.description: Free-text confirmation, e.g. firmware echo of the new user.

DeviceSnapshotSummaryDto.description: Lightweight view of a device snapshot — status + counts + error, no payloads. Use the per-id GET to fetch the full deviceInfo / users / attendance JSON.

ReconciliationExportDto.description: A generated Excel reconciliation report uploaded to object storage. The downloadUrl is a short-lived signed link the FE opens directly.

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived signed GET URL for the .xlsx.

objectKey.description: Object key in the reports bucket.

FinalizeDeviceSnapshotRequest.description: Posted by the poller when a SNAPSHOT_DEVICE task completes. Carries the captured deviceInfo / users / attendance JSON straight from the device. The service stores them on the snapshot row and flips its status to COMPLETED.

deviceInfo.description: Device metadata — firmware, serial, platform, clock, etc.

userCount.description: Convenience count of users in the dump (mirrors users.count).

recordCount.description: Convenience count of attendance records (mirrors attendance.count).

FailDeviceSnapshotRequest.description: Posted by the poller when a SNAPSHOT_DEVICE task can't be fulfilled — device unreachable, ZK error, or anything else that means there is no payload to deliver. Mirrors the sync task fail call but flips the snapshot row too.

retryable.description: Whether the underlying sync task should remain retryable. Default true — service applies the standard backoff. Pass false for permanent failures (firmware mismatch, etc.).

DeviceUserAdoptionDto.description: Outcome of adopting a completed device snapshot's user dump into the attendance_device_users bridge. Matches each device user_id (leading zeros stripped) to an employee_code; creates or updates the bridge row and skips users with no matching employee. hasFingerprint / hasFace are NOT inferred here — get_users() can't report template presence, so they stay at their current value (false on newly created rows).

totalUsers.description: Total user entries present in the snapshot dump.

updated.description: Existing bridge rows updated (privilege / syncedAt refreshed).

skipped.description: Device users with no matching employee_code — skipped, not adopted.

unmatchedUserIds.description: The device user_id values (as reported, before zero-strip) that matched no employee. Surfaced so HR can reconcile stray enrollments.

HeartbeatRequest.description: Poller posts this on every cycle (success or fail). Drives the dashboard freshness indicator. Optional fields are reported on first contact / firmware change so the catalog stays current without an HR edit.

SetDeviceCommPasswordRequest.description: Write-only set of the ZK comm password. The current value is never returned in any GET — the device DTO instead exposes a commPasswordSet boolean.

commPassword.description: Numeric ZK comm password. Use 0 to clear.

AttendanceSnapshotDto.description: Per-employee aggregated attendance snapshot for a payroll period.

lopDays.description: Days marked ABSENT in the period.

CreateShiftOverrideRequest.description: Operator override over a date range, applied per employee. Triggers same-tx recompute of every attendance_records row in the range.

DeletePunchRequest.description: Operator hard-delete of a punch. Reason is required and goes onto the audit trail; the row itself is removed and the day's attendance_records are recomputed.

BiometricBatchRequest.description: Bulk ingest from attendance-poller. Each entry is a raw punch — the service resolves the employee from employeeCode (the device's user_id field IS the employee_code) via attendance_employees, drops same-time duplicates silently, and drives attendance_records re-derivation transactionally. Entries whose employee_code has no matching snapshot row are returned in skipped[] with reason UNKNOWN_DEVICE_USER and parked in the unmatched-replay queue.

IngestPunchResult.description: Outcome of a /punches/ingest call. Punches whose employee_code has no matching attendance_employees snapshot row land in skipped[] with reason UNKNOWN_DEVICE_USER; the poller logs them and they are parked in the unmatched-replay queue.

PunchRequest.description: ESS self-punch. `at` is optional — when omitted, the server uses now().

at.description: Punch instant. Server stamps now() when null.

AttendancePeriodLock.description: Lock state for a payroll-period (year + month) in attendance.

BulkOperatorPunchRequest.description: End-of-shift / paper-form bulk insert of operator punches. Each row is a single (employee, instant) punch with the operator's free-text reason. The whole batch runs in one transaction — any single row failing rolls back the lot. Cap is 100 rows per call.

punches.description: 1..100 punch rows; the whole batch is one transaction.

BulkPunchResponse.description: Per-row outcome of a bulk operator-punch insert. Either list may be empty.

BulkPunchResponse.FailedRow.description: An input row that failed to insert. {@code errorCode} is the stable {@code AttendanceErrorCode} name when the cause is a known business error.

OperatorPunchRequest.description: Operator-added punch with offline proof. `reason` is the paper-trail note ("missed checkout, paper form #12 / approved by supervisor X").

CreateDelegationRequest.description: Create or extend an approval delegation. `requestTypes` defaults to all three types when null. `toDate` null = open-ended (until revoked).

CreateDelegationOnBehalfRequest.description: HR (with APPROVAL_OVERRIDE) creates a delegation on a manager's behalf when the manager is unreachable. `reason` is required for audit.

ReorderEntryRequest.description: One entry of a bulk reorder payload — the new displayOrder for a catalog row.

displayOrder.description: New display order. Lower sorts first.

UpdateLeaveTypeRequest.description: HR-admin partial update. Any field left null is unchanged. `code` is immutable; to retire a code use DELETE (soft-deactivate) and create a new type.

UpdateHolidayRequest.description: Patch a holiday. Null fields stay unchanged. The date is immutable — delete and recreate if the date itself is wrong.

UpdateAttendanceDeviceRequest.description: HR-admin partial update. Any field left null is unchanged. `code` is immutable; to retire a device flip `active=false` (DELETE). The ZK comm password is set via the dedicated POST /devices/{id}/comm-password endpoint, not this update path, so it cannot be exfiltrated through a leaked GET response.

deviceType.description: Reclassify this device. Most are ATTENDANCE; flip to CANTEEN or ACCESS_LOG for non-attendance units.

UpdateShiftOverrideRequest.description: Patch — null fields stay unchanged. A change to from/to recomputes the union of old and new ranges.

AmendPunchRequest.description: Operator amendment to an existing punch. Both fields are mandatory — the new instant and an audit-grade reason explaining the correction. Source / employee / device stay as-is.

reason.description: Free-text justification ("corrected per paper form #43, dial-pad lag").

EmployeeShiftDto.description: An employee's shift assignment over a time range. `effectiveTo` is null for the currently-open assignment. Returned newest-first by `effectiveFrom`; the first row whose range covers today is the active one.

shiftCode.description: Denormalized shift code at read time.

shiftName.description: Denormalized shift name at read time.

OvertimeMineRow.description: OT request enriched with the attendance-record minutes for the same (employee, workDate). Minutes are zero when the OT is still PENDING/REJECTED or when no attendance record exists for the day yet.

request.description: Underlying OT request — authorization shape, no minutes.

leaveTypeCode.description: Leave type code, denormalized for the FE.

year.description: Calendar year the cycle starts in (grouping label).

cycleStart.description: Inclusive first day of this entitlement cycle.

cycleEnd.description: Inclusive last day of this entitlement cycle.

LeaveApplyContext.description: One-shot bundle for the apply-leave drawer — all three reads the drawer needs on open. Avoids the cold-start jitter of three sequential calls. Holidays are bounded to the next 90 days from today (Asia/Karachi); past holidays are elsewhere on the calendar view.

types.description: Active leave types from the catalog.

balances.description: Caller's current-year balances, denormalized with leave type code.

holidaysInNext90Days.description: Holidays in the next 90 days from today (Asia/Karachi).

DeviceUserDto.description: An employee enrolled on a device — view of the attendance_device_users bridge row. The employee's identity on the device is the employee_code; look it up via the employee snapshot.

syncedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful UPSERT_USER for this row. Null when the row has never been pushed.

DeviceSnapshotDto.description: Full device snapshot including deviceInfo / users / attendance JSON payloads. All three are populated only when status is COMPLETED.

deviceInfo.description: Raw device metadata as the poller captured it (firmware, serial, platform, clock, etc.). Shape varies by firmware.

users.description: Users on the device. Shape: {count, users: [...]}.

attendance.description: Attendance log on the device at snapshot time. Shape: {count, records: [...]}.

DeviceUserReconciliationDto.description: One device-enrolled user reconciled against the employee mirror. The device user_id (leading zeros stripped) is matched to an employee_code; category tells HR whether to keep or un-enroll.

deviceUserId.description: Raw user_id as stored on the device (before zero-strip). Pass this back verbatim to the un-enroll endpoint for UNMATCHED rows.

employeeCode.description: employee_code matched (device user_id, zeros stripped); null when the device user_id is blank.

employeeId.description: Matched employee id; null when UNMATCHED.

name.description: Employee full name when matched; null otherwise.

employmentStatus.description: Employment status from the mirror when matched (ACTIVE / TERMINATED).

DeviceReconciliationSummaryDto.description: Counts of a completed snapshot's device users by reconciliation category. Lets the FE show the breakdown without fetching the full per-user list.

matchedActive.description: Matched to an ACTIVE employee — keep.

matchedInactive.description: Matched to a non-ACTIVE (e.g. TERMINATED) employee — un-enroll candidate.

unmatched.description: No matching employee_code — stray enrollment, un-enroll candidate.

PollerTargetDto.description: Active device the attendance-poller should pull from. Carries comm password — do not surface this DTO outside the attendance.poller surface.

commPassword.description: ZK comm password — sensitive, gate to attendance.poller.

lastPunchedAt.description: High-water-mark; the poller filters its ZK pull to records strictly after this. Null on a fresh device — pull everything.

AttendanceRecordDto.description: Per-day attendance projection. Shift fields are the snapshot — they do NOT change when the shift catalog or assignment changes.

paid.description: §7.payroll #23 — paid-leave flag. Populated when status == LEAVE from the leave type's paid column at approval time. Null on every other status.

AttendanceRecordsPage.description: Org-wide attendance records list, page-by-page. Each row carries the upstream record plus a compact `employee` summary (name, code, department, photo) so the FE can render the table without an extra fan-out per row. Pagination metadata mirrors the upstream PageResponse 1:1.

EmployeeSummary.description: Compact employee row for resolving names against an id list. Used by the approvals inbox, payroll composites, attendance composites, and any surface that comes back keyed by employee id without names attached.

employeeCode.description: Human-readable employee code (e.g. FS-2026-0042). Also the RFID/punch-card number used by attendance devices.

departmentName.description: Department name, looked up from the catalog.

sectionName.description: Section name, looked up from the catalog.

designationName.description: Designation title, looked up from the catalog.

profilePictureUrl.description: Signed URL for the employee's profile photo.

AttendancePunchesPage.description: Org-wide punches list, page-by-page. Same contract as AttendanceRecordsPage — raw punches enriched with a compact `employee` summary. Primary table for the attendance-operator's daily reconciliation.

OrgPulseDto.description: Org-wide attendance roll-up for a single date. One SQL aggregate over attendance_records — feeds the HR dashboard's `OrgPulse` card and avoids the BFF pulling per-employee status rows just to bucket four numbers.

NotCheckedInDto.description: An active employee whose shift-start + grace has already elapsed today without a check-in punch. Derived live at read time — nothing is persisted, and the row drops off the list the moment a punch arrives. Distinct from the settled ABSENT status the nightly close writes.

fullName.description: Full name (from the attendance-side employee mirror).

shiftId.description: Resolved shift id for today; null on override-only days.

graceMinutes.description: Grace minutes applied to the shift.

cutoff.description: Cutoff time after which a missing check-in counts (shiftStart + grace).

minutesOverdue.description: Minutes elapsed past the cutoff as of the query time.

OrgAttendanceDayDto.description: Per-day org-wide status counts. Used by the HR dashboard's 30-day trend and any other surface that wants attendance volume over time without joining across 312 × 30 rows on the FE.

OperatorDashboard.description: One-shot daily view for the attendance-operator persona. Headlines + the two lists the operator most often acts on (missing checkouts, late arrivals) plus volume stats (today's punches / overrides / pending regularizations). Underlying calls all fan out in parallel; permission gating is on the upstream calls. Default date is today (server-local Asia/Karachi).

totalPunchesToday.description: Total punches recorded for this date — across every source.

activeOverridesToday.description: Number of shift overrides whose range covers this date.

pendingRegularizations.description: Open regularization requests pending approval (org-wide count).

missingCheckouts.description: Employees who punched in but haven't punched out yet — primary operator action queue. Capped to keep the dashboard payload bounded.

OperatorDashboard.AttendanceRow.description: Daily attendance record + the compact employee summary used everywhere.

AttendanceToday.description: One-shot Today screen. Replaces 4–5 round-trips: today's attendance record, today's punches, any active approved leave that overlaps today, today's holiday, next upcoming holiday/leave, and a 3-bucket balance summary.

today.description: Today's projection. Null when the day hasn't produced a record yet (no punches, nightly close not run).

activeLeave.description: Approved leave covering today; null when no overlap.

todayHoliday.description: Today's holiday; null on working days.

AttendanceToday.BalanceSummary.description: The three buckets the Today header shows. Codes match the leave-type catalog — anything else is rolled into the corresponding bucket by name match (ANNUAL/SICK/CASUAL).

AttendanceToday.TodayRecord.description: Subset of AttendanceRecordDto plus the shift snapshot — the FE needs both to render schedule + worked time on the same card.

AttendanceMonth.description: Calendar month view. Each day's `kind` is the FE's render hint — pick the single overlay that wins for that cell. Precedence (high → low): HOLIDAY > LEAVE > the record's status (PRESENT, ABSENT, HALF_DAY, WEEKEND).

days.description: Per-day rows for the month, in chronological order.

kind.description: Render hint — one of PRESENT, ABSENT, LEAVE, HOLIDAY, WEEKEND, HALF_DAY.

AttendanceMonth.DayLeave.description: Compact leave overlay — full request lives elsewhere.

EmployeeHeatmapDto.description: Per-day status + late-variance for an employee in a given month. Server-side rollup so the FE doesn't have to walk per-day attendance rows just to render the heatmap (D-S5 in BFF_WISHLIST.md).

status.description: PRESENT | LATE | ABSENT | LEAVE | HALF_DAY | HOLIDAY | WEEKEND.

varianceMin.description: Late minutes the day variance bar shows; 0 for non-PRESENT days.

EmployeeTodayDto.description: Per-employee 'today' projection. Always 200 — when no punches and no nightly close have produced a record yet, state is NOT_PUNCHED and record is null.

state.description: PRESENT when a record exists; NOT_PUNCHED when no record exists yet.

record.description: Today's attendance record, or null when state == NOT_PUNCHED.

CanteenUsageDto.description: Per-employee canteen usage over a date range, derived from CANTEEN-typed device events. `days` is the count of distinct calendar dates; `weeks` is the count of distinct 7-day chunks measured from the 1st of the month (days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–28, 29–end).

days.description: Distinct dates with at least one canteen punch.

weeks.description: Distinct 7-day chunks (from day 1) with at least one canteen punch.

ApprovalsInbox.description: Combined approvals inbox. The three downstream pending-approvals lists fan out in parallel, then each row is enriched with an `employee` summary in one additional batch resolve. Counts are pre-computed for the badge UI.

ApprovalsInbox.Counts.description: Per-bucket counts plus the total — drives the badge in the nav.

ApprovalDecisionRow.description: An approval decision (APPROVED or REJECTED) the caller closed at one stage of one request. Unified across leave / OT / regularization.

decidedAt.description: When the caller closed the stage.

requestCreatedAt.description: When the underlying request was created — used to compute decision latency.

endDate.description: LEAVE: toDate. Null for OVERTIME / REGULARIZATION.

Authorization.description: Paste the access token returned from POST /auth/login (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
Authorization.name: Authorization
